messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up — we just got 3 requests for enablement next week (Dedicated onboarding + migration deep-dive). Need to consolidate office-hours and a workshop agenda.
Jonah (CS): Which accounts?
Maya (CSM): Acme (prod migration), NovaHealth (dedicated onboarding), LumenHealth (pilot ramp). All asking for live sessions Wed/Thu next week.
Priya (Enablement): I can do Wed morning PT but limited to 60m. Do we want a single 60m workshop or separate 30m sessions per account?
Lina (Customer Success Manager): For Acme and NovaHealth we should do account-specific 45m + 15m shared Q&A. LumenHealth is small — 30m should suffice.
Andre (Solutions Eng): Recommend we include a short runbook + checklist and a quick demo of the routing/fallback policies. If we do 45m, propose agenda: 1) goals & scope (5m) 2) architecture & infra mapping (15m) 3) demo: model pinning/rollouts (15m) 4) troubleshooting/playbook (10m)
Sam (SE): I can cover the demo and the troubleshooting playbook. Can we record and share notes? Also need access to customer configs beforehand.
Maya (CSM): Yes recording + notes. I'll request config snippets and a short pre-read from each customer. Can someone share a template ask?
Priya (Enablement): Using this template works — please paste in the thread and I'll reuse:
```
- Environment: Hosted/Dedicated/Private
- Model(s) in use and versions
- Peak qps and expected latency SLO
- Any custom routing or KV cache needs
- Top 3 blockers/questions for the session
```
Jonah (CS): I'll ping the account owners for those fields now.
calendar-bot: Poll created: "Preferred slot for shared office hours (PT)" — options: Wed 9-10, Wed 10-11, Thu 11-12. Vote: <link>
Lina (Customer Success Manager): For APAC participants, can we add a 30m async Q&A later that day? Suggest recording + 30m 8am SGT slot.
Andre (Solutions Eng): Fine for me — I can wake up for 8am SGT if needed :coffee:
Maya (CSM): Action items: 1) Jonah to collect pre-reads by EOD Fri, 2) Sam/Andre cover demo & playbook, 3) Priya run shared workshop, 4) I will send invites + recording flag.
Sam (SE): Ack. Please CC me on invites and include a Zoom link with recording enabled.
Jonah (CS): Pre-reads requested to account owners. ETA EOD Fri.
Maya (CSM): Great — if poll picks Wed 10-11 PT I'll calendar-block and send agendas templates. Thanks team :v:
